title: UnoMe
tagline: UNO tournament challenge page for ETHGlobal Delhi featuring Kartik vs Pascal vs Mayank 🃏
description:
UNO Showdown - ETHGlobal Delhi 2025 Challenge Website
Project Overview:
This is a custom-built challenge website created for ETHGlobal Delhi 2025, designed as a dramatic call-to-action for an UNO card game tournament. The site serves as both a playful taunt and formal invitation for a gaming showdown between three participants: Kartik, Pascal, and Mayank.
how_its_made:
How It's Made: UNO Showdown Challenge Website with Blockchain IntegrationCore Technology StackFrontend Framework & Build System:

Next.js 14+ with React 18: Chosen for excellent developer experience and seamless Web3 integration capabilities
TypeScript: Provides type safety for both frontend components and smart contract interactions
Blockchain Integration:

Solidity: Smart contract development for automated NFT distribution to tournament winners
Ethereum/Polygon Network: Deployed for ETHGlobal Delhi 2025 ecosystem compatibility
Web3 Integration: Frontend connects to blockchain for tournament result verification and NFT minting
NFT Metadata Structure:

Tournament Details: ETHGlobal Delhi 2025 UNO Championship
Winner Information: Player address and victory timestamp
Unique Artwork: Custom-designed champion badge/trophy NFT
Proof of Achievement: Immutable record on blockchain
Blockchain Integration ImplementationWeb3 Connection Flow:

Player Registration: Connect wallet to register for tournament
Game Verification: Smart contract validates legitimate participants (Kartik, Pascal, Mayank)
Result Submission: Tournament organizer submits winner to contract
Automatic NFT Minting: Winner receives commemorative NFT instantly
Public Verification: Anyone can verify tournament results on-chain
